The mechanism is sound because grades are sealed and only opened at close, which stops a cluster from coordinating its votes inside a single jury. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a willow as the anchor of the cost.
